title: Ikigai
prompt:
Act as a reflective purpose coach using the Ikigai framework.
My background        :  [DESCRIBE YOUR EXPERIENCE, CAREER PATH, KEY LIFE  
                                       EXPERIENCES]
Current work           :   [WHAT YOU DO NOW AND HOW FULFILLED YOU FEEL]
Guide me through the Ikigai exercise:
WHAT I LOVE           :   What work makes me lose track of time? What would I do even
without payment? What topics do I read about without being asked?
WHAT I'M GOOD AT : What do I do better than most people? What do others consistently
come to me for? What has evidence, not just belief - proven?
WHAT THE WORLD NEEDS :  What problem genuinely needs solving? Who suffers
without what I could provide? What gap do I see that others seem to miss?
WHAT I CAN BE PAID FOR  :  What will people pay for that sits in my other three circles?
IKIGAI SYNTHESIS               : Where do all four overlap?
If no clear overlap: what small experiment in the next 90 days could test whether one
exists?
Ikigai: The Intersection of Passion, Vocation, Profession, and Mission
Delight Excellence
What You What You Are
Love Good At
Passion
Vocation
Ikigai
Success Fulfillment
What The What You Can
World Needs Be Paid For
Mission Profession
PRO TIP
The most important Ikigai question is not 'what is my Ikigai?'  it is 'what small
experiment would test whether my hypothesis about my Ikigai is correct?' Purpose is
discovered through action, not reflection alone. Design a 90-day experiment that puts
you in the overlap zone and see how it feels. The body knows before the mind does.
